cells.row-5-emergence|eng-composition:
(define (step-toward current target)
  (+ current (sign (- target current))))
(define (walk from to)
  (let loop ((p from) (path (list from)))
    (if (= p to) (reverse path)
        (loop (step-toward p to) (cons (step-toward p to) path)))))
(display (list (walk 0 3) (walk 2 -2)))
(newline)
cells.row-5-emergence|math-composition:
(define (direction a b)
  (sign (- b a)))
(define (monotone? xs)
  (let ((ds (map (lambda (p) (apply direction p))
                 (map list xs (cdr xs)))))
    (= 1 (length (delete-duplicates (filter (lambda (d) (not (= d 0))) ds))))))
(display (list (monotone? (list 1 2 3 9)) (monotone? (list 1 5 2))))
(newline)
cells.row-5-emergence|cs-composition:
(define (cmp a b)
  (sign (- a b)))
(define (insert x sorted)
  (cond ((null? sorted) (list x))
        ((< (cmp x (car sorted)) 0) (cons x sorted))
        (else (cons (car sorted) (insert x (cdr sorted))))))
(display (list (insert 4 (list 1 3 5 7)) (insert 0 (list 1 3))))
(newline)
